source.title: How to adjust when you are unable to progress beyond certain numbers in a program - Nerd Math
quotes: you could jump weight which is something that requires more equipment

sourceScope: The source discusses alternatives when stuck, including rep/set changes and load-based strategies. Explicit lighter-owned-load review, the existing two-difficulty trigger and the comparison reset below are Strength Lab safeguards, not a prescribed Wildman reduction algorithm.
behavior: After repeated current-comparison difficulty, a supported loaded movement can offer an explicit familiar lighter owned load. The app never selects or invents a load automatically.

Same/heavier/unowned loads, bodyweight and independent heavy/light configuration are excluded. Matched pairs use the correct owned per-implement inventory. No lighter owned load yields advice rather than a fictitious option.
Pain holds remain movement-wide. Load selection cannot enable a disabled family, confirm technique or grant prerequisite/progression credit. Active drafts and non-writers are protected.
The declared baseline is lowered explicitly and a new comparison begins. Historical sessions and policy definitions remain intact; actual completed new work is needed for each new exposure/stage.

Known receipt identities and the review day bound the comparison so quality/date corrections, prior cycles and already-known future work cannot restore a heavier baseline or certify fresh review/return work. Later ordinary higher-load choices retain their own anchor semantics.

storageCompatibility.notes: Only an explicit rebuild-load selection writes this optional comparison metadata alongside existing weights/nextWeights/loadResetAfter fields. Existing V33 data needs no migration; storage namespaces and historical records are unchanged. Atomic persistence and backup validation cover the new boundary.

longitudinalResult.scope: Synthetic actual engine-generated work, declared user review choices and reported feedback; not evidence of physical outcomes or universal maintenance frequency.

limits: No automatic load decrease, new load percentage, maximum test or physical technique certification.
The full #259 temporary alternate volume subcycle remains separate work.
Movement-specific maintenance frequencies, instructional verification and physical Android acceptance remain open.
All ten gate areas remain unresolved.
